title: pip
source_message_text:
* When the user taps the PiP icon, the video should switch to a floating mini-player inside the app, so the user can continue browsing.

* If the user presses the home button while the mini-player is floating, it should switch to system Picture-in-Picture (PiP) mode.

* It would also be nice to have an Auto PiP option, so when the user presses the home button, PiP opens automatically.
